description: Columbus, MS — Today, In a new deeply reported piece, The Bulwark's Lauren Egan chronicles a day on the campaign trail with District Attorney Scott Colom and lays out, in detail, why a growing list of national reporters, strategists, and Democratic groups are paying close attention to Mississippi's U.S. Senate race — and why, as Egan writes, the eyerolls are starting to fade.
